decision_contract.question: Does the sign of the prior one-hour EURUSD midquote change predict the sign of the next four-hour midquote change better than a development-frozen constant-direction baseline?

feature_contract.source_identity_basis: Operator confirmed cTrader Desktop 5.10.16, account ACCOUNT_REDACTED and Tick data from server; the CSV has no embedded account or mode metadata. CLI rows match sampled 2020 windows.
feature_contract.source_time_basis: CSV timestamps are treated as UTC because 1–2 January 2020 rows match UTC cTrader CLI exports; this is an explicit retrospective assumption.

secondary_reports: accuracy and paired difference by calendar quarter
eligible and ineligible anchors by UTC month and reason
forward midquote change by prediction class

cost_contract.economic_execution: No order, fill, spread, commission, financing or slippage claim is made.
cost_contract.upgrade_rule: A tradable action or net-payoff claim requires a new child hypothesis with a frozen execution and cost contract and independent validation.

data_sufficiency_policy.visibility_limit: The CSV was obtained in 2026 and has no actual historical available_at. The assumed visibility cannot support strict historical replay.
data_sufficiency_policy.case_status_rule: Generate every scheduled anchor before reading outcomes. INPUT_MISSING means an input quote is absent or stale. If inputs pass, OUTCOME_MISSING means the settlement quote is absent or late. Otherwise the anchor is MEASURABLE.
data_sufficiency_policy.intervening_gaps: Report observed gaps, but gaps outside the required input and settlement windows do not invalidate this path-independent target.
source_limitations: Historical server quote visibility is assumed, not observed.
Many 2020 EURUSD bid/ask pairs are equal and broker execution costs are unverified.
A single pair and a single later half-year cannot establish broad temporal or instrument transport.

validation_windows.access: Independent evaluator only until candidate and baseline are frozen.

search_space: No optimization; one deterministic candidate rule and one development-frozen baseline.
validation_release_rule: After independent evaluation, release the full case audit and metric report, including null and failed results. A changed rule, threshold, source or window becomes a new child hypothesis and does not reuse this validation as untouched holdout.
